# Quit Smoking Hub

> A structured knowledge and experience platform for people trying to quit smoking:
> nicotine dependence, withdrawal, cravings, triggers, relapse and evidence-based
> cessation methods. Community experiences are de-identified and clearly separated
> from scientific evidence. This file lists the pages of smokingcessation.pages.dev; the
> structured research and evidence database lives in the companion data site at
> data.smokingcessation.pages.dev.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/): quit smoking with better information — three entry points: quit, withdrawal, relapse.
- [Start Here](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/start/): first steps, quit date, preparation checklist.
- [How to Quit Smoking](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/quit-smoking/): evidence-based overview of the quitting process.
- [Nicotine Withdrawal](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/withdrawal/): symptom overview with science vs community distinction.
- [Cravings](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/cravings/): why cravings happen and how to manage them.
- [Smoking Triggers](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/triggers/): trigger database (coffee, alcohol, stress, driving, etc.).
- [Relapse & Recovery](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/relapse/): lapse vs relapse, recovery after a slip.
- [Real Quit Experiences](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/experiences/): de-identified structured community experience database.
- [Quit Methods](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/methods/): cold turkey, gradual reduction, NRT, behavioral support.
- [Quit Smoking Medications](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/medications/): NRT, varenicline, bupropion, cytisine evidence pages.
- [Quit Timeline](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/timeline/): hour-by-hour, day-by-day, year-by-year — science vs community.
- [Popular Questions](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/questions/): direct answers to common quit-smoking questions.
- [Quit Tools](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/tools/): practical tools and checklists.
- [Research Highlights](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/research/): key studies in plain language.
- [Methodology](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/methodology/): how community data is collected, de-identified and evidence-checked.
- [Medical Disclaimer](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/disclaimer/): what this site is and is not.

## Withdrawal symptom pages

- [Anxiety](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/withdrawal/anxiety/): why quitting can raise anxiety and how it settles.
- [Appetite](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/withdrawal/appetite/): increased appetite after quitting.
- [Concentration](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/withdrawal/concentration/): focus difficulties in early quitting.
- [Constipation](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/withdrawal/constipation/): gut slowing after nicotine removal.
- [Cough](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/withdrawal/cough/): the post-quit cough and why it happens.
- [Cravings](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/withdrawal/cravings/): craving as the longest-lasting symptom.
- [Fatigue](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/withdrawal/fatigue/): tiredness while the body adapts.
- [Headache](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/withdrawal/headache/): early headaches and caffeine interactions.
- [Irritability](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/withdrawal/irritability/): short-tempered early weeks.
- [Mood](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/withdrawal/mood/): low mood during withdrawal.
- [Restlessness](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/withdrawal/restlessness/): feeling on edge without cigarettes.
- [Sleep](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/withdrawal/sleep/): sleep disruption in the first weeks.
- [Weight change](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/withdrawal/weight-change/): appetite, weight gain and how to manage it.

## Community patterns

- [Alcohol & social occasions](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/patterns/alcohol-social-occasions/): the most reported relapse setting.
- [Health-scare motivation](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/patterns/health-scare-motivated-quit/): health events as the decisive quit trigger.
- [Daily check-ins](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/patterns/daily-check-in/): check-in rituals as a long-term commitment device.
- [Just one cigarette](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/patterns/just-one-cigarette/): how single cigarettes end quits.
- [Post-relapse heavier smoking](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/patterns/post-relapse-heavier-smoking/): reported escalation after relapse.
- [Smoking dreams](https://smokingcessation.pages.dev/patterns/smoking-dreams/): dreams about smoking after quitting.

## Data site (data.smokingcessation.pages.dev)

- [Data Home](https://data-smokingcessation.pages.dev/): research database and evidence library.
- [Research](https://data-smokingcessation.pages.dev/research/): structured research records with evidence strength (17 records).
- [Guidelines](https://data-smokingcessation.pages.dev/guidelines/): clinical guidelines from WHO, USPSTF, NICE, US PHS.
- [Cessation methods](https://data-smokingcessation.pages.dev/cessation-methods/): evidence comparison of quit methods.
- [Behavior change](https://data-smokingcessation.pages.dev/behavior-change/): the science of behaviour change in quitting.
- [Nicotine](https://data-smokingcessation.pages.dev/nicotine/): what nicotine is and how dependence works.
- [Withdrawal](https://data-smokingcessation.pages.dev/withdrawal/): the science of withdrawal symptoms.
- [Medications](https://data-smokingcessation.pages.dev/medications/): evidence pages for cessation medications.
- [Health Effects](https://data-smokingcessation.pages.dev/health-effects/): what smoking does and what quitting changes.
- [Relapse](https://data-smokingcessation.pages.dev/relapse/): relapse evidence and risk factors.
- [Definitions](https://data-smokingcessation.pages.dev/definitions/): defined terms used across the platform.
- [Controversies](https://data-smokingcessation.pages.dev/controversies/): honest treatment of contested topics (e-cigarettes, gradual vs abrupt, dual use).
- [References](https://data-smokingcessation.pages.dev/references/): full bibliographic reference list.
- [Community Data overview](https://data-smokingcessation.pages.dev/community-data/): how the experience database is compiled.
- [Community Data statistics](https://data-smokingcessation.pages.dev/community-data/statistics/): live-computed database statistics.
